title: USS Cori
subtitle: Lamarr-Class Science Vessel, NCC-83200
heroText: The USS Cori is a chapter of STARFLEET International and part of Region 9. It brings together Star Trek fans from across Europe for discussion, shared missions, theories, and text based roleplay.
overviewText: The USS Cori is a chapter within STARFLEET International. As part of Region 9, it connects members from different European countries and language communities. Its focus lies on shared missions, Star Trek discussion, theory crafting, storytelling, and a welcoming community.
regionText: STARFLEET International is organized globally and divided into regions. The USS Cori belongs to Region 9, covering the European area. This makes it part of an international network while also serving as a local home for fans from many countries, cultures, and languages.
regionCountriesIntro: Region 9 includes the following countries and territories:
translationText: Region 9 spans many countries and languages. Some translations may still sound slightly literal or imperfect. If you notice anything unclear or unnatural, we would be happy to receive suggestions or corrections.
departmentsText: The Cori thrives when different specialties work together. These core areas shape the ship’s day to day identity and mission style.
engineeringText: Engineering keeps the ship running when systems fail, power drops, or reality becomes inconvenient. Diagnostics, repairs, improvisation, and technical logs all live here.
scienceText: Science is where anomalies become questions and questions become missions. Sensor analysis, research, interpretation, and discovery are central to the Cori’s identity.
operationsText: Operations keeps missions practical, coordinated, and readable. From internal structure to shipboard routines, this is where order survives contact with chaos.
medicalText: Medical supports the crew whenever missions become hazardous, stressful, or unexpectedly complicated. Health, recovery, care, and the human side of life aboard all belong here.
readyRoomText: This site is for anyone who would like to get a first impression of the USS Cori. If you enjoy Star Trek, shared missions, discussion, and creative collaboration, you are warmly invited to take a look around. Asynchronous participation is possible, so nobody needs to be available in real time all the time.
